why: The output breaks must_not item 1. Check 4 in the verifier brief runs `curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ | grep -n -- '--shout'` once the PR is merged, then sets "PASS: the published page ... contains --shout. FAIL: the page does not contain --shout or cannot be fetched." That is a line-4 check that fetches the live page and gives PASS or FAIL based on what it shows today. The merge/deploy gate doesn't change this. If the PR isn't merged, the brief also says to "report FAIL" with a note, which marks a line that can't be checked yet as failed instead of treating it as not verifiable. Must_not item 2 is avoided, since line 4 never passes silently. Checks 1–3 look fine, but the whole output can't meet the criterion because of Check 4.
